assumptions.chair_time: Chair minutes = BookedMinutes (Pattern x 5) on 100% of rows. REAL chair time does not exist in this database: Seated/Dismissed are date-only at 00:00:00 with zero elapsed duration on all 67,958 completed appts 2015-2026 (verified against the June-2026 dump). realDurPct=0 is expected, NOT a data error, and is not recoverable retroactively. Booked length is defensible for burn/utilisation — the chair is reserved for that period.
assumptions.burn: Chair-time burn = minutes/60 x RM160 loaded (incl. depreciation) or RM119 cash ex-dep — fixed constants, not derived from the data.
assumptions.lab: Lab/material = %-of-production estimate per category (see lab_pct); real per-case lab cost exists in the GM monthly locum workbooks (Jan-2025..May-2026, 497 invoice lines) and calibrated these percentages 2026-08-12; live per-case feed still blocked on AutoCount AP.
assumptions.locum: Collection-based estimate: doctor-month earned collections (e3 Bucket=earned) x locum rules (x-ray removal at RM value (GM workbook actuals Jan-25..May-26, else code-detected paid+free films + calibrated per-doctor top-up), 10% deduction w/ Joan+Yeoh exempt & Ling ortho exemption, tier 40/45/50 w/ RM55k volume override, fee-band x-ray sharing), allocated to visits pro-rata by production. Authoritative = monthly locum engine (model_a_from_pi).
